prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
Seamless dark slate stone texture — base color slate, subtle variations
from slightly bluer to slightly greyer, very faint mineral veining. A
quiet background surface.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor field-journal texture study on aged parchment, centered as a seamless surface plate with museum-archive framing. Dark slate stone rendered in fine nib-pen hatching and loose watercolor wash — deep blue-grey (#2E3A4F) as the dominant field, shifting in subtle tonal variations toward cooler steel-grey and muted slate-blue across the surface. Very faint mineral veining traced in dilute ink, hairline-thin, meandering naturally through the stone face. Aged parchment grain visible beneath the wash, with faint foxing at the margins. Matte, contemplative surface — no gloss, no glow, no hard edges. Warm vellum undertone ghosts through the thinnest wash passages. Lighting flat and diffuse, as though the stone slab is documented under northern overcast light.
